title: Apes on Keys Graphic T-Shirt — Black
description: Headphones on. Personality up. A red-hoodie ape takes center stage on this black graphic tee, bringing bold color and a wide-eyed expression to your everyday rotation.
descriptionHtml:
Make room for a little character. The Apes on Keys graphic tee pairs a black backdrop with a full-color ape in a red hoodie, oversized headphones, and an A-OK cap. Red-and-white sneakers complete the look, while the “APES ON KEYS” lettering keeps the name front and center.

Wear it with denim, joggers, or your favorite sneakers. From playlist-building sessions to off-duty hangs, this is a graphic with plenty to say.

  • Black T-shirt with a centered front graphic
  • Full-body ape artwork in a bold red, white, and black palette
  • A-OK cap, oversized headphones, and red hoodie details
  • “APES ON KEYS” lettering within the artwork
callToAction: Bring the character. Shop the tee.
